Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = xlZero
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = xlInterpolated
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.ChartType = xlArea
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = xlZero: ch.ChartType = xlArea
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlArea: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = xlInterpolated: ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlArea: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlPie: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = xlZero
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlXYScatter: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = 0
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = 4
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = -1
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = 9: ch.ChartType = xlLine
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = "2"
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = 2.6
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = 2.5
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank = False
    Case 17
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank = False: ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank = True
    Case 18
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.PlotVisibleOnly = 0: ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum = -1
    Case 19
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.PlotVisibleOnly = False: ch.PlotVisibleOnly = "True"
    Case 20
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.PlotVisibleOnly = "x"
    Case 21
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered: s = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
        ch.DisplayBlanksAs = "x"
    End Select
    Tried = "ok" & s & "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 21
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function

Public Function Reopen(ByVal path As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ch As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
    Set ch = wb.Worksheets(1).ChartObjects(1).Chart
    Reopen = "|" & ch.DisplayBlanksAs & "," & ch.PlotVisibleOnly & "," & ch.ShowDataLabelsOverMaximum & "," & ch.DisplayValueNotAvailableAsBlank
    wb.Close False
End Function
